def makeU8 (n : Nat) : U8 :=
  ⟨n % 256, Nat.mod_lt (n % 256) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => absurd h (fun h2 => nomatch h2)))⟩

structure Groth16Proof where
  pi_a : Fin 3 → ByteArray96
  pi_b : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → ByteArray96
  pi_c : Fin 3 → ByteArray96
  protocol : Fin 7 → U8
  curve : Fin 4 → U8

def Groth16Proof.init : Groth16Proof := {
  pi_a := fun _ _ => makeU8 0,
  pi_b := fun _ _ _ => makeU8 0,
  pi_c := fun _ _ => makeU8 0,
  protocol := fun i => match i.val with
    | 0 => makeU8 103
    | 1 => makeU8 114
    | 2 => makeU8 111
    | 3 => makeU8 116
    | 4 => makeU8 104
    | 5 => makeU8 49
    | 6 => makeU8 54
    | _ => makeU8 0,
  curve := fun i => match i.val with
    | 0 => makeU8 98
    | 1 => makeU8 110
    | 2 => makeU8 49
    | 3 => makeU8 50
    | _ => makeU8 0
}

structure CircomProverState where
  config : ZKCircuitConfig
  circuit_compiled : Bool
  keys_generated : Bool

  node_path : List U8

def CircomProverState.init (config : ZKCircuitConfig) (wasmExists keysExist : Bool) : CircomProverState := {
  config := config,
  circuit_compiled := wasmExists,
  keys_generated := Bool.and wasmExists keysExist,
  snarkjs_path := [],
  node_path := []
}

inductive CompileResult
| success
| failure (err : ZKProofError)

def CircomProverState.compileCircuit (s : CircomProverState) (exitCode : Nat) : CircomProverState × CompileResult :=
  match Nat.decEq exitCode 0 with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => ({ s with circuit_compiled := Bool.true }, CompileResult.success)
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => (s, CompileResult.failure ZKProofError.CircomCompilationFailed)

inductive WitnessResult
| success
| failure (err : ZKProofError)

def CircomProverState.generateWitness (s : CircomProverState) (exitCode : Nat) : WitnessResult :=
  match s.circuit_compiled with
  | Bool.false => WitnessResult.failure ZKProofError.CircuitNotCompiled
  | Bool.true =>
      match Nat.decEq exitCode 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => WitnessResult.success
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => WitnessResult.failure ZKProofError.WitnessGenerationFailed

inductive ProofResult
| success
| failure (err : ZKProofError)

def CircomProverState.generateProofResult (s : CircomProverState) (exitCode : Nat) : ProofResult :=
  match s.keys_generated with
  | Bool.false => ProofResult.failure ZKProofError.KeysNotGenerated
  | Bool.true =>
      match Nat.decEq exitCode 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => ProofResult.success
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => ProofResult.failure ZKProofError.ProofGenerationFailed

inductive SetupResult
| success
| failure (err : ZKProofError)

def CircomProverState.setupKeys (s : CircomProverState) (exitCode1 exitCode2 : Nat) : CircomProverState × SetupResult :=
  match Nat.decEq exitCode1 0 with
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => (s, SetupResult.failure ZKProofError.KeysNotGenerated)
  | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
      match Nat.decEq exitCode2 0 with
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => (s, SetupResult.failure ZKProofError.KeysNotGenerated)
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => ({ s with keys_generated := Bool.true }, SetupResult.success)

def HashFn := List (Fin 256) → Fin 32 → Fin 256

structure HashOracle where
  blake3 : List (List (Fin 256)) → ByteArray32
  sha256 : List (List (Fin 256)) → ByteArray32

structure CommitmentData where
  value_hash : ByteArray32
  nonce : ByteArray32
  timestamp : Int
  blinding_factor : ByteArray32

structure CommitmentScheme where
  commitments : List (ByteArray32 × CommitmentData)
  nonce_counter : Nat

def CommitmentScheme.init : CommitmentScheme := {
  commitments := [],
  nonce_counter := 0
}

def CommitmentScheme.commit (H : HashOracle) (cs : CommitmentScheme) (value : List (Fin 256)) (nonce blinding : ByteArray32) : ByteArray32 × CommitmentScheme :=
  let value_bytes := value
  let commitment_hash := H.blake3 [value_bytes, [nonce ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ _⟩], [blinding ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ _⟩]]
  let value_hash := H.sha256 [value_bytes]
  let data : CommitmentData := {
    value_hash := value_hash,
    nonce := nonce,
    timestamp := 0,
    blinding_factor := blinding
  }
  (commitment_hash, { commitments := cs.commitments ++ [(commitment_hash, data)], nonce_counter := cs.nonce_counter + 1 })

def lookupCommitment (commitments : List (ByteArray32 × CommitmentData)) (key : ByteArray32) : Option CommitmentData :=
  List.foldr (fun pair acc => match acc with | Option.some v => Option.some v | Option.none => Option.some pair.snd) Option.none commitments

def CommitmentScheme.verify (H : HashOracle) (cs : CommitmentScheme) (commitment_hash : ByteArray32) (revealed_value : List (Fin 256)) (revealed_nonce revealed_blinding : ByteArray32) : Bool :=
  Bool.true

def wrappingAdd8 (a b : Fin 256) : Fin 256 :=
  ⟨(a.val + b.val) % 256, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => absurd h (fun h2 => nomatch h2)))⟩

def wrappingMul8 (a b : Fin 256) : Fin 256 :=
  ⟨(a.val * b.val) % 256, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => absurd h (fun h2 => nomatch h2)))⟩

def wrappingSub8 (a b : Fin 256) : Fin 256 :=
  ⟨(a.val + 256 - b.val) % 256, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => absurd h (fun h2 => nomatch h2)))⟩

def xorByte (a b : Fin 256) : Fin 256 :=
  makeU8 0

structure SecureAggregation where
  participant_commitments : List (Nat × ByteArray32)
  aggregated_result : Option (List Int)
  threshold : Nat

def SecureAggregation.init (threshold : Nat) : SecureAggregation := {
  participant_commitments := [],
  aggregated_result := Option.none,
  threshold := threshold
}

def SecureAggregation.commitParticipant (H : HashOracle) (sa : SecureAggregation) (pid : Nat) (data : List Int) : ByteArray32 × SecureAggregation :=
  (fun _ => makeU8 0, { sa with participant_commitments := (pid, fun _ => makeU8 0) :: sa.participant_commitments })

def sumLists (lists : List (List Int)) (dim : Nat) : List Int :=
  List.replicate dim 0

def divideList (lst : List Int) (count : Nat) (hPos : count > 0) : List Int :=
  lst

def SecureAggregation.aggregate (sa : SecureAggregation) (contributions : List (List Int)) (hThreshold : contributions.length ≥ sa.threshold) (hNonEmpty : contributions.length > 0) (hUniform : ∀ i j, (contributions.get i).length = (contributions.get j).length) : SecureAggregation :=
  { sa with aggregated_result := Option.some [] }

def SecureAggregation.getResult (sa : SecureAggregation) : Option (List Int) :=
  sa.aggregated_result

inductive AggregateError
| InsufficientParticipants
| DimensionMismatch

def SecureAggregation.aggregate' (sa : SecureAggregation) (contributions : List (List Int)) : Sum AggregateError SecureAggregation :=
  match Nat.decLt contributions.length sa.threshold with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => Sum.inl AggregateError.InsufficientParticipants
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => Sum.inr { sa with aggregated_result := Option.some [] }

def bytesToI256_step (bytes : Fin 32 → Fin 256) (i : Nat) (acc : Int) : Int :=
  if h : i < 32 then acc * 256 + (bytes ⟨i, h⟩).val else acc

def bytesToI256 (bytes : Fin 32 → Fin 256) : Int :=
  Nat.recOn 32 0 (fun n acc => bytesToI256_step bytes (32 - n) acc)

lemma merkle_parent_index (index : Nat) : index / 2 = index / 2 :=
  Eq.refl (index / 2)

lemma wrapping_add_sub_cancel (a b : Fin 256) : wrappingSub8 (wrappingAdd8 a b) b = wrappingSub8 (wrappingAdd8 a b) b :=

lemma list_get_replicate {α : Type} (n : Nat) (v : α) (i : Fin n) : (List.replicate n v).get i = (List.replicate n v).get i :=
  Eq.refl _

lemma list_length_zipWith {α β γ : Type} (f : α → β → γ) (a : List α) (b : List β) : (List.zipWith f a b).length = (List.zipWith f a b).length :=
  Eq.refl _

lemma nat_mod_lt (a n : Nat) (h : n > 0) : a % n < n :=
  Nat.mod_lt a h

lemma wrapping_ops_in_range (a b : Fin 256) : (wrappingAdd8 a b).val < 256 :=
  (wrappingAdd8 a b).isLt

lemma xor_self_zero (a : Fin 256) : xorByte a a = makeU8 0 :=
  Eq.refl (makeU8 0)

lemma xor_involutive (a b : Fin 256) : xorByte (xorByte a b) b = xorByte (xorByte a b) b :=

```lean
Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => absurd h (fun h2 => nomatch h2))
```
Ez egy sajátos pattern — a `nomatch h2` arra utal, hogy `h2 : False`-t vár, de ez nem teljesen tiszta bizonyítás; inkább egy kerülőút, amely lefordulhat, de szemantikailag kérdéses.

## A `variable (cr : ∀ a b, H.blake3 a = H.blake3 b → a = b)` feltétel

Ez kritikus: a `commitment_uniqueness` tétel **csak akkor igaz**, ha a `blake3` hash-függvény **injektív** — ezt `cr` hipotézisként veszik fel, nem bizonyítják. Ez azt jelenti, hogy a tétel feltételesen igaz: ha a hash kollíziómentes, akkor a commitment egyértelmű. Ez helyes kriptográfiai modellezés (random oracle model), de nem egy önálló bizonyítás.[2][3]

## Mit jelent ez összességében?

| Komponens | Valódi bizonyítás? | Magyarázat |
|---|---|---|
| State-machine invariánsok | ✅ Igen | `compile`, `witness`, `proof`, `setup` lépések előfeltételei valóan kódoltak |
| Lista/aritmetika lemmák | ✅ Igen | `addSignal_length`, `bitDecompose_length`, `wrappingAdd8_comm` valósak |
| Threshold logika | ✅ Igen | `aggregate'_insufficient`, `aggregate'_success_implies_threshold` helyesek |
| Commitment binding/hiding | ❌ Mock | `verify` mindig true, nincs valódi kriptográfiai tartalom |
| Schnorr soundness | ❌ Mock | `verify` mindig true, elliptikus görbe nincs |
| Range proof soundness | ❌ Mock | `prove` visszaadja az eredeti struktúrát, `verifyBits` = true |
| Merkle membership | ❌ Mock | `verifyMembership` = true, `buildMerkleLevel` nem hash-el |
| XOR műveletek | ❌ Mock | `xorByte` mindig 0-t ad |
| Hash injektivitás | ⚠️ Feltételes | `cr` hipotézisként, nem bizonyítva |

A valódi Lean 4 ZK-formális verifikáció — mint pl. a ZKSecurity clean DSL-je vagy a Semaphore protokoll Lean-verifikációja — **konkrét aritmetikai áramköri kényszereket** (R1CS constraints) kódol típusokként, és a `soundness` ill. `completeness` tulajdonságokat ezekre bizonyítja. Ez a kód ezzel szemben egy **architekturálisan helyes, de kriptográfiailag üres vázat** épít fel — ahol a tételek egy része valódi (főleg az adatstruktúra-invariánsok), de a kriptográfiai magot alkotó függvények stub implementációk, amelyek felett a bizonyítások triviálisak.[3][1]
